fields.statement: QA cycle 2 at a3db0fa7f with the built binary in a scratch root and HOME: rhiza daemon set rhiza.daemon.failureClassifier to a command that backgrounds a 'sleep 300' child, then sleeps 300 and would print 'transient: slow'. rhiza run start --foreground on a workflow whose command step fails took 61s and printed 'failure classifier: real: classifier failed: timed out after 1m0s'; the step ran once (no rerun), and both the classifier shell and its backgrounded child were gone afterwards (kill -0 fails; no 'sleep 300' left in pgrep). go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestShellWithStdin|TestScripts/run-failure-classifier' passes.

QA cycle 2 at a3db0fa7f with the built binary: an autonomous run whose command step fails, then the same hanging classifier (backgrounded sleep 300 child, sleep 300, 'transient: slow') and rhiza daemon --once. The daemon poll finished after 61s and logged 'watchdog: run <id> step a failure classified real, left to the inbox: classifier failed: timed out after 1m0s' (plus a poll-over-limit warning); the classifier and its child were killed. A second rhiza daemon --once finished in under a second and did not call the classifier again (no pid file written). internal/api Watchdog|Classify|Rerun tests pass from a worktree outside ~/code.
